body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001696310950415050335545972294892837228092172196872456176222…** (3046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-refit/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `d490066cb24700cb844ffe31a58e00a6f1c6d28a10fe39676b189e027eae0f43`). Applies PR2226's anticipatory dirty borrowing (Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337) to our T74 local words: 43 helpers per call are removed by borrowing dirty space from other registers (480 to 437 helpers, local mass 5590 to 5385), with frames re-solved, fresh natives, PLAN rebound and SPEC refrozen, under the PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion outer, and re-solves the frames of the borrowed gauge44 word exactly (Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), new in this package: 42 gate frames edited, gates, warps, mass 5385 and widths unchanged; local profile {1:2339, 2:509, 3:418, 4:125, 5:42, 8:8} instead of {1:2351, 2:501, 3:414, 4:129, 5:42, 8:8}; audited forward and dual by new/borrow/audit_local.py, native chain and strict assembly rerun). The supplier native and conservative complex endpoints are certified to 1e-3000 (accept at the endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-3000), grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116, and the PR1956 carried bootstrap cutoffs and PR1964 Lemma G label stage are retained. Conditional final kappa = 0.0016963109504150503355459722948928372280…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0016934383523940315190092442195145690007…(2995 digits)). Retuned to the fixed-grid maximum of PR2180 / PR2161 (dataisfire): kappa = C - 1/F - B exactly (floor grid 1e-3046, backoff 1e-3022, C the certified endpoint; outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md). It exceeds PR2269 (this package's 90-digit-endpoint predecessor without the refit) by 6.38114E-8 and PR2265 by 1.28984E-5 (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained ones plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, 17 rejecting controls). The single 3000-digit rejection moment of the strict assembly uses PR2168's exact-integer coarse exponential (code/exact_coarse.py, EXACT-ARITHMETIC-DERIVATION.json; intervals identical to the retained engine).

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `ba5e316fe247355397f63b6fcb3cfef78c11fa82` (text-only follow-ups to `fb16740ed99101ac9e39a21833ea9942f6d99dc0`: PR2286 text fixes, then public credit wording and summary rewording; kappa unchanged; then text-only README follow-up correcting stated comparison figures per #2485; kappa unchanged). Manifest: `deaab6eac95b95a66b9471535d875e49136600e837a205c5eed6cc7d45f8bb8f`.
PASS package manifest: 422 files

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse {'base': 'e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e', 'extra': '7b0e9fbda32749aabc7e156d9fe09bceb0624a178628fe69e5dfea783462f905'}; its complex endpoint 339262190083010067109194458978... brackets the ledger's b = 1696310950415050335545972294892837228092…(3078 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3081 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016963109504150503355459722948928372280…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).

Full package-owned verification passed in 131 seconds on the new head (PASS_RELEASE, kappa identical to the previous head). The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-refit/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.
